row.proto: void Ne_AnimPacketL4_SampleTrack(void *packet, void *track, uint32_t index, float time, void *out)
row.notes: The per-track sampler of NeAnimPacket_L4 (vtable 0x1458a1ba0), called from its slot +0x18 (sample, 0x143a3bc60, call 0x143a3bceb) and slot +0x58 (0x143a3bd10, call 0x143a3bd6b) and from nowhere else. rcx = packet, rdx = track (a 0x28-byte entry of the packet's track list, +0x10 key count), r8d = track index, xmm3 = time, 5th argument = the track's output; void. vucomiss xmm0,xmm3 at 0x143a3bb4e, vcvttss2si r10d at 0x143a3bb5f, movzx ecx,word [rcx+r8*2] at 0x143a3bbd2. A track of 3 or more keys compares the time only with its first key (vucomiss; jae, not taken when unordered), turns (time - first key) * rate into a bucket index with vcvttss2si, passes the signed cmp/jle against the bucket count and reads the bucket table at that index: a time that is not a number or plus infinity gives 0x80000000 and reads 4 GB below the table. The lowest float takes the first-key exit (segment 0 at weight 0); a 2-key track clamps it to weight 0 with vmaxss; a 1-key track ignores the time. Core's anim packet time guard wraps it.

verify.notes: gh:anim-packet-time-blind Blind re-derivation on d873a1c8. Factory jump table 0x145a969c8: type 1 stores the vtable 0x1458a1ba0 (lea at 0x1443b633d; NeAnimPacket_L4 sits just before it and slot +0x10 0x143a3ba50 passes that name). +0x18 = 0x143a3bc60 (call at 0x143a3bceb) and +0x58 = 0x143a3bd10 (time xmm1, call at 0x143a3bd6b) are the only references to 0x143a3bb00 (.pdata to 0x143a3bc5a). Args: rcx packet, rdx track, r8d index, xmm3 time, [rsp+0x28] output; it writes 4 floats (aligned xmmword lerp). vucomiss at 0x143a3bb4e, vcvttss2si at 0x143a3bb5f, jle at 0x143a3bb74, read at 0x143a3bbd2. For 3+ keys the only compare before the index is vucomiss [desc+0x10],xmm3; jae (not taken when unordered); then vcvttss2si r10d, the signed cmp esi,r10d; jle (passes INT_MIN), and movsxd r8,r10d; movzx ecx,word [rcx+r8*2]. -FLT_MAX takes the jae: ecx = 0, weight 0, the first key. The 2-key path computes (time - times[0]) * rate, vmaxss with 0 gives weight 0, segment 0, and nothing is indexed by time. 1-key ignores the time. Large finite times with (time-first)*rate >= 2^31 give the same INT_MIN, and a guard that maps only non-finite values leaves them. The slot +0x18 and +0x58 wrappers of L3, L4, S4, L3fp16 and S4fp16 are byte-identical apart from the call target, pass the time unchanged in xmm3, and index nothing by it, so these three entries plus B1/B4/L1 +0x18 are the minimal cover. The fp16 samplers 0x143a3b3a0/0x143a3c650 and 0x143a3a950 index through 0x143a3aae0, which sends a negative vcvttss2si result to segment 0 at weight 0 (test r11d; js 0x143a3ab67). The ntk slots 0x143a3b840/0x143a3b8f0/0x143a3cd40/0x143a3cdd0 ignore the time. Other slots (+0x20..+0x50) take no float. Same text and rip constants at Steam 26566308 0x143a3e0d0 (.tls$, read 0x143a3e1a2; called from 0x143a3e230/0x143a3e2e0 of vtable 0x1458a3d10), EA 1.0.141 0x143a28b20 (.rdata; vtable 0x1459b2de0 slots 0x143a28c80/0x143a28d30), EA 1.0.145 0x143a2b0f0 (.arch; vtable 0x1459b5f30 slots 0x143a2b250/0x143a2b300). The pattern hits once in the whole file of all four, at the hints 0x3a3bb00/0x3a3e0d0/0x3a28b20/0x3a2b0f0; it differs from the L3 pattern only in the last byte (jne +0x0e).
